A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an efficient and cost effective method to produce and recover electron beams in the two ERL's for eRHIC and for LHeC.
we have developed a new lattice for a six pass ERL with FMC lattice and we have studied the effect of beam energy spread on the beam dynamics and beam lifetime.
we have designed a 60 GeV 3-pass ERL for LHeC and a 30 GeV 6-pass ERL for eRHIC, which can provide high luminosity for the future electron-hadron colliders.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ERLs can be designed to have the same performance as a conventional linac.
the FMC lattices allow for the design of a 5-pass ERL with a single linac and a 3-pass ERL with two linacs, both with a 60 GeV beam energy.
